root_cause.text: Integer overflow in the bounds check inside `nouveau_gem_pushbuf_reloc_apply()` because `r->reloc_bo_offset` (a __u32) is added to 4 in 32-bit arithmetic, potentially wrapping to a small value and bypassing the validation against the 64-bit `nvbo->bo.base.size`, allowing out-of-bounds access.
root_cause.evidence: The patch description explains that "reloc_bo_offset is __u32 (uapi/drm/nouveau_drm.h) and the integer literal 4 promotes to unsigned int, so the addition is performed in 32 bits and wraps before the comparison against the size_t bo size." The fix casts to u64 to ensure 64-bit arithmetic.
